description.value: Rainbow Lake Castle Resort is a rustic lakeside retreat tucked into the Cascade Mountains five minutes outside Princeton, BC, offering a mix of lodge rooms and deluxe log chalets overlooking a creek. Guests can enjoy Jacuzzi tubs, lakeside picnic areas, barbecue facilities, and abundant outdoor recreation in a scenic, lesser-known valley. The property also operates an RV park and offers weekly and monthly rentals, making it a flexible base for extended stays in the southern BC interior.

address.value: 375 Rainbow Lake Road, Princeton, British Columbia Canada, V0X 1W0
